Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1276
Claimant:
Dakota Jones
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
12/31/2024
Claim opened for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant
reports neck pain with whiplash symptoms and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's
office.
01/09/2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named driver and the coverage was in force at the time of
loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
01/14/2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the lane change and the contact between the two vehicles as the claimant
described. Requested photos from the scene and a copy of the police report.
02/04/2025
Photos from the scene and the vehicle inspection show damage consistent with the reported impact. No earlier
damage to either vehicle has come to light in the records reviewed so far.
04/29/2025
Witness statement received and it matches the account given by both drivers. The witness described the sideswipe in
the same seqeunce and location.
05/29/2025
The claimant's initial statement was given through counsel. Follow-up questions added a few minor details about the
moments before and after impact, but the core account has not changed.
07/01/2025
Meidcal records reviewed. The whiplash diagnosis is plausible for this type of collision, and no prior treatment to the
neck or upper back appears in the records or in the prior claims search.
07/03/2025
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated treatment notes and a
timeline of visits from the provider to better understand the course of care.
07/07/2025
Still unclear from the statements and photos exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the moment of
impact. Asked counsel to clarify the seating position in writing.
07/15/2025
Reserve reviewed and file remains open pending the updated treatment notes and the clarification on seating
position. No coverage issues identified at this time.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
